name: DeepDream Psychedelia
summary: Photographs that a neural network fills with eyes, dog faces, pagodas and swirled fur at every scale. It started in 2015 when Google released the code that made the effect.

philosophy.core_thesis: A machine that looks for patterns finds them in everything: the picture shows what the network expects to see, and it shows it everywhere.
design_principles: Fill the frame with repeated motifs: eyes, snouts, feathers and arches at 3 to 5 sizes, from 8px to 200px.
Run 4 to 8 octaves of the effect, so that small motifs sit inside large ones.
Set saturation at 130% to 180% and push the hue toward orange, lime and magenta over a dark ground (#14102A).
Bend lines into spirals and wave fields; keep no straight edge longer than 10% of the frame.
Keep one readable photographic base, such as a landscape or a face, at about 30% visibility under the motifs.
Place a plain 16px mono caption bar at the foot of the frame with the layer name, for example inception_4c.
Loop the zoom at 12 fps: scale the image 1.03x for each frame and feed it back to the network.
anti_patterns: Clean flat colour fields with no repeated motif
Straight, geometric layouts with wide margins
Photoreal skin and soft studio light
One focal subject on an empty ground

layout.grid_mechanics: A full-bleed image with a 12-column caption area of 1 row; the image runs to the edge and the frame has no gutter.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 0% to 5% of the image stays empty; the caption bar takes 48px and the spacing scale is 8, 16 and 32px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush-left caption under a centred, full-width image; no element is centred on a motif.
layout.container_geometry: Square or 4:3 frames with a 0px radius; caption chips with a 4px radius.

font_pairings.note: Mono faces that suit layer names and code captions.
A wide display face with a neutral text face for page copy.

hierarchy_rules: Set layer names in lower case with underscores.
Keep the headline short: 3 words at most.

color.palette_structure: Four saturated hues (orange, lime, magenta, cyan) on a deep indigo ground, with one cream highlight.
color.contrast_rules: Cream text on indigo holds at least 12:1; the saturated hues carry image fields and borders, not long text.
color.surface_treatment: High-saturation texture fields of fine, repeated detail; a 3% grain; no flat fills.
color.light_and_shadow: No cast shadow; each motif has its own inner glow of 2px to 6px and a rim of lighter hue.

materiality.surface_simulation: Over-fitted feature maps: fur, scales, feathers and eyes that grow from the texture of the photograph.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px border in lime at 60% on caption chips; the image has no border.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur and no elevation; detail is sharp at every scale.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline icons at 20px with a 2px round stroke; used only in the caption bar.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Repeated eyes, dog snouts, birds, pagodas and arches that grow out of clouds, trees and faces.

motion.transition_physics: An endless zoom: each frame scales 1.03x and adds new motifs; the loop runs 8 to 12 seconds at 12 fps.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises saturation by 20% and adds one octave of motifs; active freezes the zoom.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels awe and unease: a familiar picture is full of watchers.

use_cases: explainers about how neural networks see
avoid_when: The page needs a calm, trustworthy tone.
The content is dense text that must be read at length.
The audience is sensitive to repeated eye motifs.

modifiers.how: Keep one dream object on an empty ground and cut saturation to 80%; remove the repeated motifs.
Replace the motif swirl with one smooth, over-detailed render and add a teal and amber rim light.
Swap the machine motifs for hand-drawn paisley and flower forms with a halftone ground.

pack.why: A duotone family that keeps the caption icons light on a very busy image.

ground.why: The ground repeats the spiral fur and the wave fields that DeepDream grows from a photograph.
